min_value.description: Minimum brightness value when using delta operations (e.g., '50-' will not go below this)

exponent.description: Exponent for perceptual brightness curve; 4 is recommended for perceptual uniformity (linear if not set)

save_enabled.description: Whether to save the current brightness state to a temporary file

restore_enabled.description: Whether to restore a previously saved brightness state on startup

machine_readable.description: Enable machine-readable output format (e.g., for scripting)

quiet.description: Suppress all standard output (errors still shown)

pretend.description: Pretend mode: compute operations but skip writes (useful for dry runs)
